title: Direct image of abelian etale sheaves is additive and left exact
statement: Let $u:U\to V$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. For a scheme $T$ let $T_{\Et}$ be its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and $\Ab(T_{\Et})$ the abelian category of sheaves of abelian groups on $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. For $F\in\Ab(U_{\Et})$ let $u_*F$ be the sheaf of abelian groups on $V_{\Et}$ given by $(u_*F)(W)=F(W\times_VU)$ for $W\to V$ in $V_{\Et}$, $W\times_VU$ the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] with its projection to $U$, with restriction along $g:W_1\to W_2$ the restriction of $F$ along $g\times\mathrm{id}_U$ (a sheaf by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-continuous]), and for a morphism $\varphi:F\to F'$ of $\Ab(U_{\Et})$ let $u_*\varphi:u_*F\to u_*F'$ be given by $(u_*\varphi)_W=\varphi_{W\times_VU}$. Then the functor $u_*:\Ab(U_{\Et})\to\Ab(V_{\Et})$ is additive ($u_*(\varphi+\psi)=u_*\varphi+u_*\psi$), and it preserves the limit of every small diagram; in particular it preserves finite products and kernels, so it is left exact in the sense of [def-sp-left-exact-additive]: for every exact sequence $0\to F_1\to F_2\to F_3$ of $\Ab(U_{\Et})$ the sequence $0\to u_*F_1\to u_*F_2\to u_*F_3$ is exact in $\Ab(V_{\Et})$.
